name: Bento Grid aspect ratio controls
description: Verifies scrolling to the Bento Grid and switching between canvas aspect ratios

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the Infinite Aspect Framing bento card
Verify aspect ratio options 16:9 Cinema, 9:16 Portrait, 1:1 Square, and 21:9 Ultrawide are displayed
Click on the 9:16 Portrait aspect ratio button
Verify the 9:16 Portrait option becomes active
